adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the importer does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`. If a feed item has no `content` (i.e., `i.content` is `nil`), calling `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, and there is no per-item rescue in the loop, so a single such item would abort the entire polling run.
